The '''R440 Ion Jet Engine''' was a model of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]]. Koensayr's [[BTS-A2 Long-Range Strike Fighter/Bomber]] was equipped with two such engines, which were relatively new at the time of the ship's introduction.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
